prompt_text: Who is the best dentist in Columbus Ohio for a dental implant?
answer_verbatim:
There isn’t one objectively “best” dentist for implants — the right provider depends on your specific needs (single tooth vs full-arch, bone loss, medical history), your location, and your budget. Instead of a single name, here’s a practical way to find an excellent implant provider in Columbus, plus what to look for and what to ask.

Who to look for
- Specialists for implants: oral & maxillofacial surgeons, periodontists, or prosthodontists. Many general dentists also place implants, but complex cases are often best handled by specialists.  
- Board certification, fellowship training in implant dentistry, or a prosthodontic residency are strong credentials.  
- Practices that use CBCT (3‑D) imaging and guided/surgical planning show modern capability.

Where to search
- Ask your general dentist for a referral (they see outcomes from local specialists).  
- Use professional directories: American Academy of Implant Dentistry (AAID), American Board of Oral and Maxillofacial Surgery (ABOMS), American Academy of Periodontology (AAP).  
- Read reviews on Google, Healthgrades, Zocdoc and check state dental board for disciplinary history.  
- Consider the OSU Wexner Medical Center/OSU College of Dentistry for faculty specialists and complex-case expertise.

What to check in a consult
- How many implants they place per year and experience with cases like yours.  
- Which specialist will do the surgery and who will restore the crown (sometimes two providers are involved).  
- Use of CBCT and digital planning, immediate vs delayed loading, grafting needs.  
- Examples (before/after photos) and patient references.  
- Complication rates and warranty/guarantee policy.  
- Cost estimate, payment options, and whether they coordinate with your insurance.

Red flags
- Vague answers about experience or outcomes.  
- No imaging or not offering a treatment plan in writing.  
- High-pressure hard-sell for expensive options without clear medical reason.

If you want, I can:
- Look up top-rated implant specialists in Columbus if you tell me your ZIP or neighborhood, and whether the case is a single tooth or full-arch.  
- Provide a checklist of questions to take to a consultation.

Which would you like me to do?
